item.title: Senior Software Engineer, Payments
item.description: Join the Payments team at Stripe.
item.content:encoded:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in San Francisco, CA. You will build and scale payment processing infrastructure used by millions of businesses.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Experience with distributed systems
  • Proficiency in Go, Ruby, or Java

item.title: Staff Engineer, Infrastructure
item.description: Build the foundation of Stripe's infrastructure.
item.content:encoded:
As a Staff Engineer on the Infrastructure team, you will design and build the systems that power Stripe globally. Based in New York, NY or Remote.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong systems design skills
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure
